principle: No task is forgotten: every request, integration, target or debt item is tracked here until evidence-backed closure or an explicit owner decision.

status_definitions.ci_verified: Automated tests/CI passed for the specific source commit; not a live integration or production proof.
status_definitions.implemented_pending_ci: Code and contract tests have been added on this branch; CI has not validated this change yet.
status_definitions.implemented_unverified: Code exists, but live service/provider/device behavior has not been verified.
status_definitions.open_pr: Implementation exists on a pull request that is still open/unmerged.
status_definitions.candidate_not_enabled: Candidate identified but access, entitlement, terms or actual inference has not passed a live qualification probe.
status_definitions.blocked_owner: Requires owner account access, credential setup, device authorization, billing decision or external approval.
status_definitions.needs_owner_review: Requires owner review of destination, safety, scope or a prior incident.
status_definitions.planned: Explicitly identified work that has not been implemented.
status_definitions.target_unmeasured: Strategic capacity goal; no measured validation exists.
status_definitions.pending_ci: Waiting for CI on this exact branch/commit.

tasks.title: Run bounded Codex, Gemini and Claude CLI workers with isolated task worktrees and verified handoff
tasks.evidence: PR #30 commit 743e691de48bd065cf1c7005ddbc45a3b57f239e; GitHub Actions Qudron Runtime Checks run #662 (387 tests; all workflow steps passed); ops/qudron-runtime/scripts/agent_fleet.py; ops/qudron-runtime/tests/test_agent_fleet.py; ops/qudron-runtime/tests/test_agent_fleet_binding.py; ops/qudron-runtime/agent-workers/manifest.schema.json; ops/qudron-runtime/agent-workers/run.schema.json
tasks.current_state: A single CLI launcher supports authorized Codex/Gemini/Claude CLI adapters, one isolated worktree and branch per task, up to eight parallel tasks, non-overlapping allowlists, default-denied sensitive paths, per-provider environment allowlists, process-group timeout cleanup, immutable worktree/branch/base-HEAD validation, structured acceptance criteria/expected checks/known risks, protected patch/log export, SHA-256 integrity and mandatory human review. Exact-head CI run #662 passed all 387 unit/safety tests and every workflow step, including both runtime images, Compose, FreeLLM health/authentication and timezone checks. CI uses fake CLI executables; no live vendor CLI sessions have been demonstrated. The launcher remains standalone and is not called by Qudron queue/MCP/Agent Fabric.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: On the exact release candidate, automated tests cover all configured CLI adapters, task worktrees, concurrency and disjoint-scope enforcement, secret-path denial, provider-specific environment allowlists, timeout/process cleanup, structured task notes and report schemas, safe artifacts, immutable worktree/branch/base binding, patch integrity and mandatory review. Exact-head CI must pass. A green CI result proves code contracts only; it does not prove live provider login, a secure remote host or production execution.

tasks.title: Execute and independently verify three authorized real CLI workers in separate remote environments
tasks.evidence: PR #30 worker-fleet contract; Vercel connected-team project inventory; Railway workspace inventory; Replit Qudron/QudSystem app search

Official free trial options were researched, but their credits/quotas are finite and do not establish ongoing free capacity. tasks.acceptance_criteria: Provision three separately isolated, owner-approved remote environments with dedicated non-shared HOME directories and no host-home, Docker-socket, SSH-agent or production-secret mounts; verify authorized CLI versions, exact provider account entitlements and an approved budget cap; run three non-overlapping Architecture, Development and Security/QA tasks; collect task IDs, provider/model identity, timestamps, exact changed-file manifests, immutable base/head hashes, patch hashes, sanitized logs and costs; require independent security review and human approval; run exact-head CI before merge. Never treat a worktree alone as OS isolation. Do not incur compute/API charges or inject credentials before approval.

tasks.title: Integrate the CLI worker fleet through an authenticated remote-executor service and Qudron's queue/MCP control plane
tasks.current_state: The launcher is a standalone CLI entry point and has no call site from qudron_worker.py, mcp_gateway.py or Agent Fabric. The production-safe design must dispatch to a disposable remote executor with an isolated filesystem/HOME and least-privilege credentials; running provider CLIs directly inside Qudron's core worker would expose the core runtime and must not be used as a shortcut.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Define and implement an owner-authenticated, schema-validated remote-executor contract for bounded fleet runs; persist fleet/run/task/agent/branch/worktree lifecycle in the continuity ledger; provide a remote sandbox/VM with dedicated HOME, no host mounts, Docker socket, SSH agent or production secrets; enforce provider/data-class allowlists, task-scoped paths, deny patterns, timeout, concurrency and cost caps; reconcile restart/cancel/timeout without orphaning processes or worktrees; expose status and artifacts through MCP; attach immutable base/head SHAs, changed-file manifests and patch hashes; require independent review and explicit human approval before applying a patch or merging; pass unit, integration, restart, cancellation, isolation, security and exact-head CI.

completion_policy: Do not convert a task to ci_verified or closed merely because code, documentation, a model name, a page or an adapter exists. Require evidence matching its acceptance criteria.
evidence_source_commit_semantics: Exact PR #30 code and contract commit validated by the recorded exact-head CI run.
